observable_outcome: The working directory an Invocation declares actually becomes the child process's working directory. ProcessSupervisor gains one additive Dir field, zero-value-compatible with every existing caller, and is the only place a child directory is assigned; SupervisedInvocationRunner reads Invocation.WorkingDirectory, validates it fail-closed on five properties before any preflight load or ledger reservation, and refuses rather than substituting the Runner's own directory. With confinement on, the chdir is expressed inside the namespace after the read-write remount instead of through cmd.Dir, and a directory outside the confined workspace is refused with no child started. The representative Provider, whose command line carries no path at all, therefore runs in the Increment's workspace; the two Providers whose command line carries a directory flag keep it, and the flag and the working directory are proven identical rather than assumed so. Because the change lands inside the file set the live exercise compiles, the representative Provider's live evidence is re-observed under a new owner-approved preflight record with its own ledger.
acceptance_criteria: A1. Scope boundary, written before any code. The evidence opens with a table stating, one row each: what this task makes true (the declared working directory reaches the child process), what it deliberately does not do (no new mount, no widening of what the child may reach, no removal of a directory flag any CLI's help declares, no change to what environment a child receives), what it records but does not fix (the second unconsumed field of provider.Invocation, dp-v2-077 d8), and what only V2-028 can establish (that codex and opencode accept a directory flag alongside an inherited working directory, since neither CLI has an authenticated session on this machine). A further row must state that this task passes no release gate and satisfies no M6 completion condition.

A2. Baseline, measured before changing anything, with the line numbers re-measured rather than copied from this Work Order. Record top-level test names and counts and that all pass for internal/runner (80 at the starting commit), internal/provider (57), internal/api (36) and internal/contracts (30). These counts and every line number below are from the coordinator's own reading of commit 2d1a514 and are expected to be stale: run devbox run --pure -- go test -list '.*' on each package and re-grep every cited line, and where a measurement disagrees with this Work Order use the measured value and report the disagreement rather than the value written here. Record as measured facts: no non-test file in internal/runner contains an assignment to a command's Dir field; provider.Invocation declares WorkingDirectory at internal/provider/provider.go:164; the one shared build helper sets it from req.Workspace at internal/provider/adapters.go:47; ProcessSupervisor constructs the child at internal/runner/supervisor.go:56 and its declared additive fields are Env, Stdin and Stdout; SupervisedInvocationRunner copies the supervisor and sets Stdin, Stdout and Env at internal/runner/provider.go:357-360 and calls sup.Run at :363; the live exercise constructs ProcessSupervisor{TermGrace: 3 * time.Second} with no Confine at internal/runner/provider_live_test.go:218; three further call sites construct a ProcessSupervisor with no directory, at internal/runner/confinement_test.go:141, :189, :214 and internal/api/live_local_test.go:159. Every pre-existing test must still pass at the end under its existing name with its existing assertions unchanged, and before/after top-level counts per touched package must be reported.

A3. ProcessSupervisor gains exactly one field, Dir string, and assigns it to the child. Assert: the field is documented in the type comment in the same terms Env, Stdin and Stdout are; a zero Dir produces byte-identical behaviour to the current code, asserted by running a child that reports its own directory and comparing against the test process's own directory; a non-empty Dir with Confine nil makes the child report exactly that directory; and the four pre-existing ProcessSupervisor construction sites named in A2 compile and pass unchanged. Assert by AST scan that ProcessSupervisor is still referenced from exactly one location in internal/runner/provider.go, so internal/runner/source_guard_test.go's existing pin passes under its own name; do not edit that file.

A4. The policy is in SupervisedInvocationRunner and it is fail-closed on five properties. Assert, each as its own case with no process started and no ledger entry written: an empty WorkingDirectory; a relative one; a non-canonical one (a '..' segment, a trailing separator, a doubled separator -- three separate cases); one that does not exist; one that exists but is a regular file; one that is a symlink to a valid directory. Each returns the new sentinel ErrInvocationWorkingDirectoryUnusable with a distinct wrapped reason. Assert the refusal is ordered before LoadPreflightRecord and before Ledger.Reserve by driving it with a runner whose RecordPath names a nonexistent file and asserting the working-directory reason is what comes back, and by asserting the ledger file does not exist after the refusal. Assert the happy path: with a valid workspace, sup.Dir equals Invocation.WorkingDirectory exactly, compared value to value.

A5. With confinement on, the directory is set inside the namespace and never through cmd.Dir. Assert: NamespaceConfinement.wrap emits exactly one cd, shell-quoted by the same helper the mounts use, positioned after both mount pairs and immediately before the exec, verified by inspecting the generated script text rather than by reading the source; ProcessSupervisor leaves cmd.Dir unset whenever Confine is non-nil, asserted structurally (an AST or generated-script assertion, not a comment); wrap refuses -- error returned, nothing wrapped, no child started -- for a directory that is not the workspace and not beneath it, including a sibling directory and an ancestor; and, on a kernel where Probe succeeds, a confined child reports the workspace as its own working directory and a write to a relative path inside it succeeds while a write to a relative path above it fails. If Probe fails on this machine, record every confined item as skipped with its reason and never as passed (gate rule G7).

A6. The rejected ordering is measured, not predicted, and either result is acceptable. Measure whether a cwd inherited across namespace creation -- that is, set before unshare runs, which is the only thing cmd.Dir can do when Confine is non-nil -- lets a relative upward write reach the mount that existed before the read-only remount. Run it as a positive control against the chosen ordering and record the exact result, whichever way it goes, together with the kernel identifier. State plainly in the evidence and in docs/operations/runner-local.md whether the rejected ordering is merely unprovable or actually permits a write the seal was meant to stop. Do not change the design on the basis of the result and do not adjust the test until it agrees with dp-v2-077 d4.

A7. The directory flags stay and the double expression is proven harmless for the values that actually occur. In internal/provider, assert for all three adapters that Invocation.WorkingDirectory equals req.Workspace, and that for codex and opencode it is identical to the argv element immediately following that adapter's measured directory flag, while claude carries no path in argv at all. In internal/runner, assert SupervisedInvocationRunner refuses with the same sentinel when the two disagree, driven by a hand-built Invocation. Do not remove, rename or reorder any flag, and do not execute any Provider CLI subcommand; --help and --version are the only Provider CLI reads permitted anywhere in this task. Record in the evidence that the CLI-refuses-both case is unmeasured, that measuring it needs the run subcommand, and that V2-028 owns it.

A8. The three comments and the document section that argue from the now-false measurement are corrected. Update internal/provider/adapters.go's workspace-argument comment, internal/provider/adapters_test.go's matching comment (which also states, incorrectly, that the runner reads Invocation.Environment), and the section of docs/operations/provider-adapters.md that concludes the flags are not a double expression. Each correction must state the new fact, keep the historical measurement with its date rather than deleting it, and keep the conclusion that the flags stay -- now supported by A7's equality rather than by the old premise. Assert no other line of either source file changed, by git diff.

A9. The second unconsumed field is recorded and escalated, not fixed. Record as a measured fact that SupervisedInvocationRunner never reads Invocation.Environment: Grant.Apply writes it at internal/runner/secret_broker.go:92-98, Run builds the child environment from the approved record's base names at internal/runner/provider.go:333-345 and passes that to sup.Env at :360, and only FakeInvocationRunner observes the field. Record that the defect is latent because every live exercise so far ran with granted_names empty, name the owner of the follow-up, and change no behaviour. Do not make a grant reach a real child in this task: that widens what the child may reach and belongs to a task with its own credential-isolation acceptance.

A10. Live re-observation of the representative Provider, under a new owner-approved record. Before any invocation, confirm and record: that internal/runner/supervisor.go, internal/runner/provider.go, internal/runner/confinement.go and internal/provider/adapters.go are inside the compiled group of .agents/v2/evidence/artifacts/V2-075-live-exercise-files.json, measured by loading the artifact with the argv it publishes; that the intersection between this task's diff and that 76-path set is therefore non-empty, printed as the path lines themselves; and that V2-075's ledger stands at 12 of 12 with halted false so its record may not be reused, raised or re-initialised. Then issue .agents/v2/provider-preflight/V2-077-provider-live-claude-workdir.json with task_id V2-077, its own limits.ledger_path, approval.subject_path pointing at .agents/v2/packets/provider-standing-authorization.json and approval.subject_digest measured from that file's real bytes, approval strictly earlier than observed_at, and a --version verification argv. Re-run the same nine-subtest exercise ev-v2-075 covered, not widened, and publish this task's own exercised file set plus its own measured-empty intersection from the new observation commit, with the same positive controls V2-075 used. If the approved record does not exist, stop and escalate: land the code and the unit evidence, record the live item as not run with its reason, and never record it as passed.

A11. The live re-observation must state what actually changed for the child. Record, from the re-observed exercise, the working directory the real claude child ran in, that it is the Increment's workspace and not the Runner's directory, and whether any observed behaviour of the CLI differed from ev-v2-075's record -- including whether it asked anything about its new working directory, and whether its own state or configuration lookups changed. Retain no prompt, no instruction text, no response text and no marker value; retain only what an operator needs to audit the run (session ids, usage counts, durations, turn counts, the sha256 of the projection, environment identifiers). If the exercise fails because the CLI behaves differently in an empty workspace, stop and escalate rather than widening what the child may reach in order to make it pass.

A12. Documentation. docs/operations/runner-local.md records that the declared working directory now reaches the child, the five refusal properties, the confinement ordering with A6's measured result stated plainly, and that the working directory is now the resolution base for every relative path a child resolves. docs/operations/provider-adapters.md carries A8's correction. docs/operations/provider-live-claude.md gains a section for this task's record and ledger, states that V2-075's ledger is exhausted and that a new approved record is the only path, and leaves the V2-017, V2-063 and V2-075 sections as historical record without rewriting them. Do not edit docs/operations/v2-task-dag.md, docs/architecture/**, docs/preview/** or docs/stable/**.

A13. Determinism. No fixed sleep, no wall-clock timer and no goroutine in any new test. Unconfined assertions run a child that reports its own directory and exits; confined assertions reuse the existing bounded marker-file deadline poll in internal/runner/confinement_test.go rather than introducing a second waiting idiom; refusal assertions start no process at all. Run devbox run --pure -- go test -count=1 ./internal/runner ./internal/provider three times in sequence with the live gate unset and record that the verdict line and the output are identical each time, and run it once with -race. Judge every run by the verdict line, not by the shell exit status.

A14. Measured notes for V2-045, recorded and not acted on. Record that this task creates no new import edge: internal/runner/supervisor.go gains no import, the validation lives in internal/runner/provider.go which already imports os and path/filepath, internal/runner/confinement.go already imports both, and internal/provider gains no import because A7's assertions are test-side and A8's change is a comment. Record that it moves the runner, provider and docs component keys. Name V2-045 as the owner of the remaining key movement under gate rule G6. Because this design creates no edge, a red manifest or dependency-coverage check in make check means the design was departed from: stop and escalate to the tech_lead and do not edit ci/components.json, Makefile, go.mod, go.sum or devbox.*.

A15. Chain position, recorded as a fact for the coordinator. Record that this task touches none of the six surface-chain file groups -- the api handler, internal/application's ports, service and read models, contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml, internal/web/owner.{html,js}, and either store adapter -- and that internal/web/** is prohibited here by design rather than by omission, because the outcome has no owner-visible value to render and inventing one would require an openapi change and put the task in the chain. Record that the task must still be serialized against any other task editing internal/runner or requiring a live claude invocation, because the subscription and the ledger are single-holder resources.

A16. Evidence. Create .agents/v2/evidence/V2-077-runner.json (id ev-v2-077-runner, component runner), .agents/v2/evidence/V2-077-provider.json (id ev-v2-077-provider, component provider) and .agents/v2/evidence/V2-077-provider-live-claude-workdir.json (id ev-v2-077-provider-live-claude-workdir, component provider-live-claude), each with task_id V2-077 and correlation_id v2-077-child-working-directory, recording for every check the argv actually executed, the working directory, the timeout and a summary stating the measured result, with every acceptance item traceable to a named check. Record the execution environment identifier (uname -srm, go version as resolved inside devbox run --pure, devbox environment, and for the live record the machine identifier and the CLI's absolute path and version). A skipped test is recorded with status skipped and never counted as a pass (gate rule G7). Register the records with appended entries in .agents/v2/evidence/index.json whose evidence_hash is the sha256 of each artifact's final committed bytes; touch no other task's entry. devbox run --pure -- go test -count=1 ./internal/contracts must be green with the records in place. Any digest written in prose must match the .gitleaks.toml allowlist shape: 64 or 40 hex characters with at most one trailing punctuation character, and never two revisions joined by a two-dot range.

A17. Component evidence keys, measured not predicted. The evidence_key recorded in each artifact is that component's key read with devbox run --pure -- make evidence-keys on the final tree where make check is green, with every touched file already git-added: a new file not yet in the index is invisible to the git ls-files based input set the key derives from. Do not copy a key from any earlier record, and do not treat key equality as a freshness claim for the live record -- ev-v2-075 established that the freshness claim is the observation-commit-plus-empty-intersection pair, and this record must make the same claim in the same form.

A18. Evidence key count is measured, never predicted. The number of evidence keys that move is the transitive closure of the declared dependencies and has been larger than predicted in every one of the last four tasks (predicted 7 measured 13; predicted 8 measured 14). Read the closure with devbox run --pure -- make evidence-keys on the final green tree and issue the records with the values that tree reports; if the count differs from what this Work Order implies, use the measured value and report the difference.

A19. Secret scan before every commit, on the ledger directory only. Run devbox run --pure -- gitleaks dir .agents --config .gitleaks.toml before each commit that touches .agents/**, and record the verdict. Do not run gitleaks dir . as the pre-commit scan. No prompt, no raw Provider response and no credential value in any form may appear in any file this task writes.

A20. devbox run --pure -- make check is green, and it is re-run after the evidence commit so the secret scan reads committed history rather than an uncommitted tree. Record both runs, with the commit each ran at, and judge them by the verdict line rather than by the shell exit status. No file outside allowed_paths changes.
constraints: Work only inside the assigned isolated task worktree; never push.
Never use git reset, git checkout --, git stash or git commit --amend.
Do not remove, rename or reorder any command-line directory flag that a CLI's own help declares. codex keeps -C and opencode keeps --dir.

Do not treat the mount namespace as a substitute for pointing the child at its workspace, and do not add, remove or change any mount. The confinement's two mount pairs and their order stay exactly as they are; the only addition to the generated script is one shell-quoted cd after both pairs.
Do not widen what the child may reach in order to make the directory take effect. If a directory can only be made to work by relaxing the confinement, refuse the directory.

Fail closed, never fall back. An unusable Invocation.WorkingDirectory is a refusal with no process started; substituting the Runner's own directory is forbidden, because that is the defect this task removes.
The refusal must happen before LoadPreflightRecord and before Ledger.Reserve. A reservation debited before a refusal stays charged at worst case forever.
Do not change what environment a child receives. Invocation.Environment stays unconsumed in this task: record it and escalate, and do not make a Secret Broker grant reach a real child process here.

Do not execute any Provider CLI subcommand for measurement. --help and --version are the only permitted Provider CLI reads. The live exercise's invocations are the only Provider invocations permitted, and only under the new approved record.

Do not reuse, edit, raise or re-initialise the V2-017, V2-063 or V2-075 preflight records or their ledgers, and do not clear a halted flag. V2-075's ledger is at 12 of 12; a new approved record with its own ledger path is the only path to a live invocation.

Do not edit ev-v2-017-provider-live-claude, ev-v2-063-provider-live-claude-refresh, ev-v2-075-provider-live-claude-rebind or .agents/v2/evidence/artifacts/V2-075-live-exercise-files.json. Publish this task's own exercised file set as a new artifact.
Do not edit internal/runner/source_guard_test.go or internal/provider/source_guard_test.go. If either guard turns red, the design was departed from: stop and escalate.

Do not touch internal/web/**, internal/api/**, internal/application/**, internal/store/**, contracts/** or cmd/**. This task is deliberately outside the surface-widening serialization chain and must stay there.

Do not touch ci/components.json, Makefile, go.mod, go.sum or devbox.*. This design creates no new import edge, so a red manifest or dependency-coverage check in make check means the design was departed from: stop and escalate to the tech_lead.
Do not edit contracts/release-contract/** and do not weaken any capability declaration there.
Do not edit .agents/v2/task-state/** or any .agents/v2/packets/** file.

Do not write a module-path string literal into any source or test file: internal/ci's manifest check reads such a literal as an undeclared edge and turns make check red. Build any needed path by concatenating a prefix with a suffix.

Determinism is acceptance, not preference: no fixed sleep, no wall-clock timer, no goroutine in any new test. Every wait is a bounded deadline poll, and a measured duration is logged as an observation, never asserted as a threshold.
A skipped test is never counted as a pass (gate rule G7). Record every skip with status skipped and its reason, and record the execution environment identifier for every run.

Never write a verification as passed that was not actually executed. If an acceptance item cannot be satisfied -- in particular the live re-observation, which depends on an owner act -- stop and escalate to the tech_lead rather than fabricating or weakening it.
Retain no prompt and no raw Provider response, and no credential value in any form, in any file, log line or evidence record.
Run devbox run --pure -- gitleaks dir .agents --config .gitleaks.toml before every commit that touches .agents/**; never use gitleaks dir . for that scan.
Any digest written in prose is 64 or 40 hex characters followed by at most one punctuation character. Never join two revisions with a two-dot range in committed text.
Every pre-existing test must keep passing under its existing name with its existing assertions unchanged. Report before and after top-level test counts per touched package.

Every line number and test count in this Work Order was read at commit 2d1a514 and is expected to be stale. Re-measure each one with go test -list and grep, use the measured value, and report every disagreement.
